title: mc-cuda-tinygrad probe payload
subtitle: kda/ and probes/ as one archive, for the Kaggle kernels
description: Payload for the mc-cuda-tinygrad Kaggle kernels: the KDA reference and TinyGrad port, the backend probes, and the semantic camera. Built by kernels/pack.py in the mc-cuda-tinygrad repo. One tarball, sha256 in payload.sha256, per-file hashes in probe/MANIFEST.json.
